long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Alright, corporate drones, listen up!

Your multi-billion dollar EV just got recalled because the "future of driving" won't let you roll down a window. Turns out, a simple breath of fresh air now requires a software patch, a dedicated diagnostics team, and probably sacrificing a goat to the algorithm gods. Progress! We've traded manual cranks for an existential crisis about basic aerodynamics. Subscribe for more corporate burns.

short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Alright, gather 'round the digital water cooler.

Guess who just "streamlined operations" by laying off 10,000 employees? Your friendly neighborhood tech megacorp, obviously. All to bankroll a "revolutionary" AI chatbot that *exclusively* hallucinates soup recipes like "Sour Cream and Broken Dreams Gumbo." Because apparently, job security is less valuable than a bot suggesting cream of mushroom with a hint of existential dread.
